competitor_alerts: Simcha Kosher Catering and A Taste of the World dominate 'kosher catering Dallas', plus a 'A Kosher Catering Services of Dallas' site and Meat Point's catering page.
Delivery-app category pages (Uber Eats, DoorDash, Postmates) and Yelp own 'kosher delivery' searches; The Hungry Rooster does not appear on any of them in results.
Aderet Grill & Salad and Dallas Kosher directory pages rank for restaurant/food terms; Dallas Kosher (supervision org) is an authoritative listing to get onto.
OneTable and Chabad of Dallas rank for Shabbat meals, while thehungryroostertx.com/shabbat is not showing.
No brand-new Dallas kosher caterers surfaced in news search this week.

summary: The Hungry Rooster appears in only 2 of 7 target keyword searches (kosher catering at #10, Jewish catering at #8) and is absent for food, restaurant, delivery, and Shabbat terms, which are dominated by directories, delivery apps, and community sites. The homepage has a good title and description but no JSON-LD structured data, and /menu, /catering, /shabbat, /reviews all load. Top priorities are structured data, directory/review listings, and stronger catering and Shabbat page content.
